mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about IBSA: 1. It was founded in 2003 through the Brasilia Declaration. 2. The IBSA Trust Fund is managed by the World Bank. 3. IBSAMAR is its naval exercise. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: UNOSSC (manager of IBSA Fund) is hosted by UNDP, so 'managed by UNDP' is arguably true; replace with clearly false body, key unchanged

patterns: APPSC asks one-line current-affairs facts on groupings: new BRICS member (Argentina, Aug 2023), host city of G20 2025 (Johannesburg), G20 Bali / India theme statements.
Other PSCs: which set are all G20 members, Quad non-member (China), first BRICS summit Yekaterinburg 2009, G20 presidency handover, IBSA summit venue.
Many PYQs filed here are unrelated current affairs (sports, bilateral MoUs) - real grouping questions are few and membership/venue based.
App MCQs cover membership, origins and institutions well; they add statistical shares, 2026 BRICS theme and debate/opinion items that PYQs do not test.
